I've been super interested in this for a while now! Wondering what's the official move for this. I guess there is no official move haha, just start working on it. Sending you a DM We can make a micro-gc and then see where it goes! If you have any comments/questions you can dm me about it will do! thanks for offering it! Official fellows will already have support through EPF. It will depend on the scope of the project. Implementing verkle in Nim is going to be a bigger undertaking, so it could likely support a larger group working on it. Is it other than the stipend. can official fellows expect some support with visa invitation letter, accommodation ? I am interested in that but still on the research and reading stage. Will pick up learning the Nim language next How true is this statement about ZKP vs EVM not TUring complete enough for the calculation involved only a formal language or formal model of computation can or cannot be Turing-complete. What the image is saying is that in principle the EVM can perform any computation, but if the execution takes too long, it cannot. For example, if a verifier is not efficient it will cost a lot of gas. Got that! So Although its Turing complete, if the computaion will be more than the block allowed gas, it becomes impossible right? Not an EVM limitation, just a security to not stalk the EVM like some Denial of Service for upcoming blocks correct? Yes. Necessary travel and accommodations. We can also help with visa invitations.

excerpts.author: dp_specialist
excerpts.content: only a formal language or formal model of computation can or cannot be Turing-complete. What the image is saying is that in principle the EVM can perform any computation, but if the execution takes too long, it cannot. For example, if a verifier is not efficient it will cost a lot of gas.
